identity.title: C-SDLC doctor should reject repository drift and non-executable owned-path plans

values.task_boundary: Repair the false-ready diagnosis without changing product scope or lifecycle authority.
acceptance_criteria: Repository identity drift is diagnosed deterministically.
Owned paths that cannot route a declared new Rust module are diagnosed.
Missing validators are rejected unless explicitly declared and deferred with fail-closed semantics.
Validation requires a nonzero issue-specific denominator.
Focused regression fixtures reproduce issue 5795's false-ready shape.
